batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c DJ Jacobs b KA Pollard

balls.text: a yorker well outside off, Dilshan steers it behind point for a single, actually make that two since there is an overthrow and Bangalore finish on 140
shot! Dilshan opens himself up and swats that powerfully over midwicket for six, this was a length ball from Malinga, he will stick to the yorker for the final ball

superb from Malinga, another inch-perfect yorker on legstump, Tiwary squeezes the ball back down the track as he couldn't get under it, batsmen run through for a single, there was a run-out chance if Malinga had collected the ball cleanly
Dilshan gets this one away to third man for another single
yorker on legstump, can't do much with that, Tiwary gets his front leg out of the way and gets the ball towards mid-on
this time Tiwary stands his ground, Malinga perhaps expects him to back away and bowls a wide down leg
streaky but Tiwary couldn't care less, he was backing away to make some room, Malinga follows him with a near yorker, which Tiwary somehow manages to edge between his legs for four
punched towards long-off for a single

not exactly a fifty to savour for Dilshan, nowhere near his explosive best, and he gets there with a poor stroke, a full toss way outside leg that he tries to reverse-sweep, mishit towards the off side
into the blockhole, Tiwary jams it towards the off side for a single
a fullish ball is driven towards extra cover
Tiwary mows that one over midwicket, Harbhajan from round the wicket, aesthetics isn't something Tiwary cares about, ugly but effective batting
low full toss on middle, swiped towards deep midwicket
finishes the over with a yorker just outside leg, blocked by Tiwary
Tiwary latches on to the short ball from Malinga, he jumps on to the front foot and slashes the ball over covers for a boundary
Saurabh Tiwary's first ball is a yorker on legstump, Tiwary gets his front leg out of the way and blocks it towards the off side

Asad Pathan again tries to confuse Malinga by moving around in the crease, Malinga isn't going to be fooled by that, he slings in the usual yorker that sneaks between the batsman's legs to crash into the stumps, another wicket for Malinga
low full toss on the pads, batsman shuffling around in the crease, just about gets bat on the ball, poked down the track

Dilshan knew little about that one, he was scampering away from the stumps as Malinga sent a short of length ball angling into leg, too quick for Dilshan, who somehow gets the ball towards point, I thought he was looking to play towards leg
worked towards midwicket for a single
Pollard has struck, de Villiers attempts to smash the ball towards midwicket, like Kohli he too gets an edge, the ball loops towards the bowler, who takes an overhead catch
balls.dismissal: AB de Villiers — caught and bowled

balls.text: length ball outside off, bit of bounce, de villiers looks to pull it but can't connect, well kept by Jacobs
tries the Dilscoop, makes a mess of it, no need to meet the dentist but he is hit on the helmet and the ball rolls toward short third
high full toss, Dilshan mows it for six behind backward square leg, that was high enough to be a no-ball but it wasn't called, Dilshan asks the umpire why it wasn't
Dilshan makes some room and looks to work it through the off side, he can't connect
there's more of what the Bangalore crowd is he to see, de Villiers dances down to get to the pitch and hammers that over midwicket for six
Dilshan's struggles continues, he charges out to a short of length ball and can only tap it down the track
that's a poor ball and he gets away with it, a full toss way outside off, slapped straight to sweeper cover
the arm-ball from Murtaza, de Villiers doesn't read it, he was looking to smash it over midwicket, he misses, the ball misses the legstump, and the keeper also misses it, four byes
mistimed by de Villiers as he looks to cut that one
well bowled by Murtaza, de Villiers backs away from leg, Murtaza fires it full and wide, de Villiers can't reach it
low full toss on offstump, Dilshan drives it inside-out past Tendulkar at extra cover for four
stifled appeal for lbw, Dilshan looks to sweep that one but is struck on the pads, that was going down
full ball in middle and leg, pushed towards mid-on
short of length and outside off, guided to short third man
fired in fast and into the pads, worked towards square leg
full ball on middle, driven to the left of midwicket
Harbhajan speared it down way down the leg side
overpitched ball on offstump, driven towards cover for a single
full ball on middle and off, patted back to the bowler
an ugly shot from de Villiers, shortish ball is flat-batted towards long-on for a single
another boundary for Bangalore, start of the final flourish? a bit of width from Pollard, de Villiers steers that towards short third man, a diving Malimga can't stop that one
slapped towards sweeper cover for a single
short of length on legstump, sliding further down, Dilshan shuffles across and whips it in the air towards deep backward square leg, one-bounce four
stabbed towards backward point for a single, and Munaf completes another tidy over
low full toss on offstump, thumped just wide of long-off for a double
one more single, down to long-on this time, how long before Bangalore launch the onslaught?
short of length and around off, batsman skips away from the stumps to make room, jabs the ball towards cover
full ball on legstump, tapped towards mid-on for a single
Munaf returns, Dilshan looks to slash the first ball through cover, edged down to third man
Dilshan stays beside the line and looks to thwack it past cover, again can't get it past the fielder
worked to midwicket for one more
bit of width again, slapped square for a single
finally Dilshan's drive works well, a bit of width and Dilshan lashes it past point for four
way down the leg side, batsman looks to powerfully sweep it past short fine but can't beat the man
down the leg side once more, off the pads towards midwicket
length ball on legstump, defended to the leg side to end the over
slashed towards sweeper cover for a single
full ball it is thrashed down to long-on for a single
slightly overpitched on middle, pushed back to the bowler
full and way down the leg side, keeper comes across to block it
fired down the leg side, Dilshan looked to sweep that one, but it is off the pads behind square leg, Dilshan not at his best today
short of length and outside off, de Villiers skates down the track and works the ball towards long-on for another single
and once again eased to long-on for a single
pushed the ball towards long-on to amble a single
slaps this towards sweeper cover to pick up a single
rubbish ball down the leg side,thanks says de Villiers as he helps it down to fine leg for four

ooh, Bangalore survive a couple of close calls, first Dilshan looks to drive through the off, he gets an inside edge that bounces to midwicket, where Tendulkar fires the ball to the keeper, de Villiers had to dive to make his ground, a direct hit would have made it interesting, it was still interesting as de Villiers' bat was in the air after he dived, his gloves just about pass the crease before the bails are removed
Franklin starts with a length ball outside off, driven uppishly past cover for a single
gets well forward and eases the ball towards long-on for a single, time for the time-out
looks to defend off the front foot, struck on the pads
works this one towards deep backward point for a single
massive appeal for lbw, fullish ball that Dilshan wanted to power through the leg side, hit on off and middle, that looked very close, Dharmasena turns it down, time to have UDRS here?
angling into middle stump, defended towards midwicket
Harbhajan starts with a legstump ball, swept powerfully down to deep backward square leg for four
quicker one, punched back to the bowler
full ball outside off, driven to long-off
full ball and on legstump, dug out towards cover point for a single
pushed towards short cover by de Villiers
lovely stroke from de Villiers, makes room and lashes that overpitched ball over cover for four, first boundary since the third over
full ball is driven towards mid-off
short of a length and slanting into legstump, works it towards square leg
bowled from wide of the crease, opens the face to steer the ball to short third man
full ball on legstump, whipped towards square leg
tucks this towards the midwicket for a single
Dilshan looks for his favourite shot, the carve through cover, but can't beat the fielder
just outside off, de Villiers dabs it towards short third man
pushed towards extra cover, and a single is pinched
this one comes in to the batsman, de Villiers defends after getting well back in the crease
driven along the ground towards long-off for a single
fired into the pads, batsman can't get bat on it, ball dribbles back down the track
length ball on middle and off, AB de Villiers eases it to mid-off to get off the mark
Ali Murtaza's first ball is first, Dilshan looks to muscle it through covers, the timing is terrible
on middle and leg, pushed towards midwicket for a single
length delivery outside off, pushed to the left of the bowler, who stops it
jags back from short of a length, solidly defended back to the bowler

Kohli is gone, Pollard has struck, a length ball that Kohli looks to smash across the line towards midwicket, get a edge and the ball soars a mile into the air and the wicketkeeper Davy Jacobs takes that skier
again it is on the pads, again the batsman can't connect, off the pads towards midwicket
the offcutter slides too far down the leg side
length ball slipping down leg, Kohli wants to whip it behind square, it's off the pads
Dilshan is beaten as he looks to poke the ball outside off, Malinga may be deadly, but Munaf has just gone for three runs in his first two overs, not bad at all
Munaf remains accurate, defended by Dilshan, another dot ball by Munaf
Kohli shuffles across and nudges it towards square leg for a single, it was a similar shot to the one that he couldn't pull off earlier in the over
Munaf sticks to short of a length, Kohli pushes it back to the bowler, good stuff so far from Munaf
Kohli looks to whip that towards square leg but doesn't get bat on it
angled in from Munaf, tucked towards midwicket by Dilshan
short of length ball outside off, Dilshan jumps as he plays that towards third man for a single
Malinga fires it in full again, Kohli gets his leg out of the way and clips it towards deep square leg
pushed towards mid-on by Kohli
length ball on the pads from Malinga, whipped down to deep backward square leg for a boundary, good shot that

oh, that looked close, it was a low full toss fired into legstump, Kohli's bat doesn't come down at all, he is hopping around after being struck on the boot, I think that would have slid down leg side
length ball outside off, off the leading edges and over cover, Kohli was looking to power that down the ground, that was fortunate for Kohli
shortish ball outside off, Kohli slashes the ball down to third man for a single, the Dilshan v Malinga face-off is postponed a touch
just a bit of width, Kohli opens the face and steers the ball towards backward point
just outside off this time, punched off the back foot towards mid-off by Kohli
looks to whip the ball towards square leg, off the pads towards point
Munaf sticks to his favourite "back of a length", defended by the batsman from the crease
Munaf's first ball slides towards the pads, and it rolls off the pads behind square leg
no maiden for Malinga, Kolhi eases the ball towards mid-on and sprints through for a single
shorter this time and well outside off, guided towards Pollard at backward point, a wicket maiden to start the match?
Malinga pings a good length and just outside off, defended towards cover by Kohli
this was a short of a length and outside off, Kohli is beaten by that one as he looks to push towards the off side
defends this one off the back foot towards backward point

wow, Malinga does what he does best, one of the two hometown boys in Bangalore line-up is cleaned up first ball by a yorker, and unlike his usual yorker that swings in, this one moved away, Agarwal was looking to defend down a middle-stump but that swerves and takes out offstump

Tendulkar picks off the winning runs, it was way outside off, delicately worked behind point by Tendulkar for four, Tendulkar once again bats through the innings to bring up Mumbai's second win in two matches
short and wide, slapped to point
gets forward and drives it towards Pujara at point
overpitched and well outside off, Tendulkar punches it towards extra cover, hit too well to have time for a single
works this one towards deep square leg
Rayudu has been in brilliant form today, he comes down the track and scythes this one through covers for a boundary, even Vettori applauds
low full toss outside off stump, driven to the left of the bowler
full ball outside off, Tendulkar bends his knees and opens the bat face to steer the ball towards third man
Mumbai are walking to victory, carved towards sweeper cover for a single
muscled towards long-off, a very straight hit but there isn't enough power to beat the fielder, just a single
slapped towards point for a couple
massive cheer from the Bangalore crowd as Tendulkar eases the ball towards long-on to get to his fifty
very short from Pathan but he gets away with it, swiped to midwicket
full and outside off, Rayudu can't reach it

rubbish fielding from Tiwary, Rayudu has reached his half-century, it was a length ball from Pathan, Rayudu comes down the track and lofts that inside-out to long-off for four, Tiwary lumbered towards it but couldn't stop it
slaps this in the air towards deep backward square leg for a single
a length ball outside off, Rayudu drives to the cover fielder
looks to guide this one off the backfoot towards third man, can't connect
Rayudu gets on the front foot and whacks that one to the long-on boundary, top shot from Rayudu
looking to play the ball to the leg side, edge past the keeper's right for a single

nearly a run-out, Tendulkar drops the ball to the leg side and sets off for a single, then he stops, Rayudu was already charging down and was nearly three-quarters the way down, Zaheer sprints to get to the ball and throws the ball at the non-striker's end but misses, and Rayudu survives
Tendulkar moves across and looks to paddle the ball to fine leg, gets a bottom-edge towards short fine
eased down to long-on for a single
overpitched and just outside off, driven towards cover
Tendulkar pushes it towards the off side for a single
works it towards point for a single
gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes that past extra cover for four
jags away after pitching just outside off, left alone by Tendulkar
a bit of width, slapped towards sweeper cover for a single
Rayudu opens the face to drop the ball from middle stump towards point, decides against the single
was perhaps trying the slower ball, it all goes wrong for Zaheer, ends up as a high full toss which Rayudu swipes towards midwicket for four
length ball on offstump,defended back down the track by Rayudu
Zaheer's back and he starts with a short and wide ball, Rayudu dismisses that past point for four, superb shot from Rayudu
full toss to end the over, a thick inside-edge towards the on-side from Tendulkar
once again Tendulkar shows T20 isn't all about power, he just lofts this over the bowler's head with little effort, great timing from Tendulkar
full and outside off, driven along the ground towards long-off for a single
nicely pitched up and outside off, Tendulkar drives it to long off for an ambled single
a high full toss this time and again Mumbai can't put it away, powered towards sweeper cover
that is a terrible delivery, a full toss that Tendulkar slaps to cover
Tendulkar makes room and works the ball towards point for a single
the legspinner continues to pitch it short, Tendulkar carves this one but can't beat cover
once more Pathan drops it short, muscled to long-on for a single
turns away after pitching on middle, tucked towards midwicket off the backfoot
dances down to get to the pitch and drives it inside-out towards long-off
Asad Pathan's first ball is far too short, Rayudu opens himself up and slams it to deep midwicket for four
on legstump, pushed off the back foot towards mid-on for a single
nurdles it behind square leg for a single
full ball that Tendulkar defends
tapped towards cover point for a single
once more Rayudu is beaten outside off, tossed up by Vettori who got that one to turn quite a lot, again the ball spins past the outside edge
Rayudu is beaten as he looks to defend, the ball turns away from him and he can't connect
length ball spinning in, tucked to the leg side
clipped towards deep midwicket for a couple
forced down towards long-on for a single
swept powerfully by Tendulkar down towards Agarwal at deep backward square leg, where the fielder lets it through for a boundary
ooh, this time Tendulkar attempts a deft leg glide past the keeper,can't connect with that outside off ball
short ball to start from Dilshan, Tendulkar gets the front leg out of the way and slams the ball towards deep midwicket for four
good over from Vettori, a bit of width on the final ball, Tendulkar rocks back and slaps it towards deep point for a single, just four off the over
low full toss on middle and leg, driven down towards long-on for a single
looks to defend this one on the front foot, flighted a touch and is inside-edged onto the pads
on middle and off, tucked behind square for another single
tucks this one towards midwicket for a single
defends the first ball back towards the bowler
he deals with it in the usual Tendulkar style for Powerplays, he opens up his stance and slugs the ball towards deep midwicket, it was a length ball from Mithun, dismissed by Tendulkar
no-ball, short of length and outside off, guided towards short third
a deft push towards deep point for a single to Tendulkar
short of length and outside off, Rayudu drives this towards sweeper cover for a single
Rayudu is attacking Mithun here, he comes down the track and crashes it past extra cover for four
short ball and outside off, Rayudu moves across and flat bats the ball over wide long-on for four
slanting into the pads, Mithun gets away with it as Tendulkar can only whip it down to fine leg
outside off, and batsman can't connect, good start from Kohli
carves this one towards sweeper cover for a single
a hit-me full toss on legstump, Rayudu clips it to deep midwicket
back of a length ball into middle and off, pushed off the back foot towards extra cover
short of length ball outside off, slapped towards cover off the front foot
Kohli's first ball is driven back towards the bowler
great stop from Mayank Agarwal at deep backward square leg, superb shot from Tendulkar before that, jumps across the stumps and whips the ball from outside off
Tendulkar plays it with soft hands towards backward point, he sets off for a single but then decides against it
opens the face to steer the ball towards third man and get off the mark
shuffles across the stumps and whips the ball towards deep midwicket for a single
angled into the batsman, defended back down the track
the Tendulkar straight drive makes an appearance, Mithun tries to get his right leg in its way but can't, the ball races to the boundary
it is a wicket maiden, a length ball on legstump to finish the over, played towards midwicket
low full toss just outside off, driven towards mid-off, a maiden wicket for Nannes to start?
tests him with the bouncer now, Rayudu defends off the backfoot, edged onto his thigh pad
a yorker on middle stump, 141.5kmh, nudged towards square leg
the Davy Jacobs show is over, Nannes cleans him up, Jacobs moved too far away from legstump, it was a full ball which he couldn't get bat on, ball thuds into middle stump and leaves it on the ground
Nannes starts with a length ball on middle and leg, driven towards mid-off
Tendulkar makes room but mistimes his drive towards cover
length ball on legstump, driven towards mid-on
jabbed towards point by Tendulkar
that is a length, just a bit of width, Tendulkar powers that past cover for four
overpitched and into middle and leg, a poor piece of fielding at mid-on concedes an extra run
a wristy flick towards deep midwicket
angling across the batsman, Tendulkar was looking to leave that and the ball hits the top of the handle, and drops at his feet
swings down the leg side, off the pads and the ball dribbles towards square leg
length ball, inside-edged on to his pads
another boundary, length ball just outside off, lashes it past mid-off, this time he stays in the crease, powerfully hit, 14 off three balls now
massive, Jacobs making merry here, takes a couple of steps down the track and slams a fuller ball on legstump over deep midwicket for six, the ball sails over the fielder
Jacobs is charging out to most deliveries from Zaheer, it was a short of length ball that Jacobs hammers through covers for four
on legstump, whipped towards deep midwicket for a single
flighted ball, full and on middle, defended
pushed towards mid-off for a single
full and on legstump, a lovely flick from Tendulkar, great placement that, beats the infield, but not Tiwary at deep midwicket
full and down the leg side, tucked down to short fine leg
Tendulkar defends his first ball off the front foot
length ball just outside off, gets forward and defends it towards mid-off
tucked him up from round the wicket, looked to work it to the leg side but can't get it away, Zaheer gives Jacobs a stare
what a shot that is, Jacobs has assaulted that one, AB de Villiers says 'Oh dear' as Jacobs flat bats a short of length ball over long-on and into the dug out
big wide that, pitches outside leg and moves further away, de Villiers flies across to stop that
length ball outside off, dabbed towards point by Jacobs
Jacobs is down the track first ball, takes a couple of paces to push the ball towards mid-off
